title: Woman in Wheat Field
prompt: A young Black woman with dark skin and long flowing black hair lies supine in the center of a vast field of tall, dense, golden-brown wheat and dry grass that surrounds her like an ocean. She wears a loose, flowing off-white dress with sheer puffed sleeves. Her arms are spread out to her sides, palms open, eyes closed with a peaceful expression. Dramatic warm golden hour side lighting from the left creates strong highlights on the grass and her figure, cinematic chiaroscuro, highly detailed textures, moody and ethereal atmosphere, realistic photography
